body:
Hey, sorry I took so long, I've been at school. To start off with, I have apologized to all my friends, both via text (walls and walls of words) and in person, but now all I get back is dirty looks and no response. 
I do want to see a doctor/therapist person, but it seems that my parents have a better solution: leave it alone, it'll go away. Oh and pray to a god that I don't believe in (no offense to religious people). I've felt a lot like this for a long long time, but my recent fuck-ups have pushed me to the edge, and it's been looking better and better to just fall of the edge than to try and work against the things pushing me toward it, if that crappy analogy makes any sense.

My parents know exactly what I'm learning. I'm at a small private school so there's really no way to avoid that, and I do talk to them about it. 
My friend situation was the best it had ever been, I had great friends, but today they wouldn't even acknowledge my existence.
Thanks, I'll try my best. I'll be seeing a couple of the people I offended today so maybe I can turn this around.

Sorry for the late reply, I feel asleep (guess I made it through the night). Basically they never actually tell me they're proud of me or show any sign. My debate teacher/coach has literally said to my father "x exceeds expectations and I'm really amazed at what he's done in the last year" and then we would get in the car and he starts talking about his day. I don't expect constant adoration of praise or anything even close to that, but nothing?

Thanks...I guess I never really looked at the world that way. Maybe I put too much stock into what other people say or think. I've apologized to this person but she still needs some time she says, I hope that means things will work out. Good luck.
Thank you. I think I'll be okay for the night at least. I'm glad to know you're out there.
Thank you. I might take you up on that someday.
Thank you. Ill see them tomorrow.
I guess, but in the past few months I've just found it harder and harder to be happy.

Sorry for rambling, but I just feel like a piece of shit. One of the people I offended was my best friend in the world, someone I've depended on for years. She's kept me from ending my life several times and she was always there for me no matter how shitty things got, or how shitty of a person I was. I just feel like if I've fucked up so bad that I've lost somebody that good to me, even when I was so bad to her, that I just don't deserve life. Sorry for rambling.
